wiki.summary: "what's wrong with me" is the fourth track revealed from Olivia Rodrigo's third album, "you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love," released on June 12th, 2026. The song was debuted on June 6th during a performance for "Primavera Sound 2026", featuring Robert Smith from The Cure. Read more on Last.fm.
